abbott_smith_html:
κατα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;]
to cover up; mid., to cover or veil oneself: 1Co.11:6; τ. κεφαλήν, 1Co.11:7.†
(AS)

occurrences.bsb: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.
occurrences.kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.

occurrences.bsb: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.
occurrences.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
